# Town of Plainfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Plainfield, Cemetery Commission organizational minutes, March 9, 2026: the selectboard appointed Andy Hebert (seat 2026-2031), Judy Hammack (2025-2030), and Mary Morton (2025-2029), each 5-0, and noted 'for the record' Lydia Vitale (elected 2025, term to 2027) and Nancy Ellen (elected 2025, term to 2028). The commission is FIVE members; the post's seat count is corrected from 3 to 5 in this sweep, disclosed on issue #163.

Town of Plainfield, Listers page (live): the October 5, 2026 Annual Lister's Meeting notice names Sandy Ross, Kayle Hope, and Jeffrey Slaton (already recorded) as the town's listers. Hope's page biography states she was 'elected in 2024'; Ross's basis is the page presentation.
